import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Cumulative']

    ws.cell(r,9).value = '=COUNTIFS(\$G\$14:\$G\$185,G{r},\$J\$14:\$J\$185,\"open\")'.format(r=r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
